title: Dream sweep Liberty to earn first WNBA Finals berth since 2013 - ESPN
description: The Dream finished the Liberty with an 85-83 win in Game 3 to advance to the WNBA Finals for the first time since 2013.

title: Trump hits International Criminal Court with sanctions after Nobel goes to former judge - The Washington Post
description: The sanctions are aimed at cutting the ICC off from the global financial system and include threats of punishment for countries that do business with the court.

title: Attacks on airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia leave 3 dead as Iran-backed Houthis escalate conflict - Fox News
description: The Saudi General Authority of Civil Aviation said three people were killed Thursday in attacks against King Khalid International Airport. Iran-backed Houthis have been targeting Saudi Arabia, a U.S. ally, in one of the latest fronts of the U.S.-Iran war.
